title: For-Profit Membership Agreement
version_or_date: No version or date printed; blank template (effective 'January 1, ____'); PDF generated on request 2026-09-30

parties.licensor: Linguistic Data Consortium (LDC), passing through only the rights it has obtained from its data providers and corpus authors
parties.licensee: Member: a for-profit corporation, for the organisational unit and sites named in Exhibit B

permitted_use.value: Use of received LDC Databases for linguistic and language-based research and technology development; portions may go into the Member's own commercial work products, subject to law and any user agreement.

ai_training_rights.value: Not named. Training/fine-tuning/evaluation is covered only implicitly by 'language-based research and technology development' at listed sites; embedding 'portions' in commercial products allowed; redistributing the data is barred; model outputs not addressed.

field_of_use.value: Linguistic and language-based research and technology development only; anything not explicitly permitted is excluded.

territory.value: Site-locked: use solely at the geographical sites (and organisational unit) listed in Exhibit B.

term_duration.value: Membership runs by calendar-year membership year, renewing each January 1 unless the Member gives 60 days' notice; the document does not say whether rights in data already received end on non-renewal.

sublicensing.value: No sublicensing or redistribution; for user-agreement databases access is limited to employees/consultants who signed in advance, with the Member liable for consultants.

derivatives_and_model_outputs.value: Member may incorporate portions of the databases into its own work products, including commercially, to the extent the law and any user agreement allow; model outputs not separately addressed.

attribution.value: Member must give appropriate reference to LDC resources in scholarly publications that mention the data.

audit_rights.value: LDC may inspect the Member's file of signed user agreements on request; no broader audit right.

warranties_by_provider.value: None: data is as-is; LDC, data providers and corpus authors disclaim all warranties, including conformity with documentation.

indemnity.value: One-way: Member defends and indemnifies LDC and its people for any use violating the agreement, a user agreement or law (incl. copyright); no cap; LDC gives no indemnity.

liability_cap.value: LDC, its host institution, data providers and corpus authors exclude all liability, including direct damages; no cap stated on the Member's side.

payment_and_revenue_share.value: Annual non-refundable membership fee: Standard USD 34,000 (up to 16 databases from the year), Subscription USD 40,000 (all databases released that year); extras at non-member price; some databases need separate licences and fees.

change_of_terms.value: LDC may amend the fee schedule and Exhibit A licensing terms at the start of a new membership year; user agreements supersede the membership agreement for their databases.

prohibited_uses.value: No copying, redistribution, transmission, publication or any use beyond the explicit grant.

deletion_on_termination.value: Only for user-agreement databases: Member must end access for individuals no longer meeting the user agreement's conditions; no general deletion duty on non-renewal.

claims.statement: The LDC For-Profit Membership Agreement licenses the Member to use the LDC Databases it receives for linguistic and language-based research and technology development.

sources.quote: for the purposes of linguistic and language-based research and technology development

claims.statement: The LDC for-profit licence is limited to use solely at the geographical sites the Member lists in Exhibit B.

sources.quote: solely at the geographical sites listed in Exhibit B

claims.statement: Exhibit B of the LDC for-profit agreement asks the Member to name the organisational unit the membership applies to and the locations where LDC materials will be used.

sources.quote: indicate the name of the organizational unit to which this LDC Membership applies, and specify the location(s)

claims.statement: Under the LDC for-profit agreement the Member may incorporate portions of LDC Databases into its own work products, including for commercial purposes.

sources.quote: Member may incorporate portions of the LDC Databases into its own work products, including for commercial purposes

claims.statement: The LDC for-profit agreement makes the right to incorporate portions into work products subject to law, including copyright law, and to any applicable user agreements.

sources.quote: to the extent permitted by law, including federal and state copyright laws, and, if applicable, by any necessary user

claims.statement: The LDC for-profit agreement gives the Member no right to copy, redistribute, transmit, publish or otherwise use LDC Databases for any purpose not explicitly permitted.

sources.quote: Member shall have no right to copy, redistribute, transmit, publish or otherwise use the LDC Databases for any other purpose

claims.statement: The LDC for-profit agreement says LDC grants the Member the same rights LDC has obtained in each LDC Database, i.e. a pass-through of upstream rights.

sources.quote: LDC shall grant to Member the same rights LDC has obtained in all LDC Databases

claims.statement: The LDC for-profit agreement requires the Member to give appropriate reference to LDC resources in scholarly publications that mention the data.

sources.quote: Member shall give appropriate reference to these resources in scholarly publications whenever data resources are mentioned

claims.statement: For certain LDC Databases the Member must restrict use to employees or consultants within its control who have first signed separate user agreements.

sources.quote: restrict use of these Databases to only those of its employees or consultants within its control who, in advance

claims.statement: Where LDC requires a separate user agreement for a database, that user agreement's terms supersede the For-Profit Membership Agreement.

sources.quote: the terms and provisions of any such User Agreements supersede the terms of the Membership Agreement

claims.statement: A for-profit Member may elect not to receive LDC Databases that require separate user agreements.

sources.quote: Member may elect not to receive LDC Databases for which separate user agreements are required

claims.statement: The Member must keep all signed user agreements on file for inspection by LDC on request.

sources.quote: Member shall maintain all signed user agreements on file for inspection by LDC upon its request

claims.statement: The Member must cut off an individual's access to user-agreement databases once the user agreement's conditions no longer apply to that person.

sources.quote: terminate access to the specified LDC Databases to individuals for whom the conditions contained in the user agreement

claims.statement: The Member is liable for its consultants' acts and omissions with LDC Databases as though they were the Member's own.

sources.quote: responsible and liable for the actions and omissions of those consultants as though they were the actions of Member

claims.statement: Under the LDC for-profit agreement the Member defends, indemnifies and holds harmless LDC and its employees, trustees, officers and agents.

sources.quote: Member shall defend, indemnify and hold harmless LDC, its employees, trustees, officers, and agents

claims.statement: The Member's indemnity covers any use of LDC Databases by the Member or its people that violates the agreement, a user agreement or any law, including copyright law; no cap is stated.

sources.quote: any use of the LDC Databases by Member, its employees, directors, officers or agents which violates this Agreement

claims.statement: LDC Databases are provided as-is: LDC, its data providers and corpus authors make no representations or warranties of any kind.

sources.quote: LDC, AND ITS DATA PROVIDERS AND CORPUS AUTHORS MAKE NO REPRESENTATIONS OR WARRANTIES OF ANY KIND, EXPRESS OR IMPLIED

claims.statement: The LDC disclaimer extends to any warranty that the data conforms with the documentation provided.

sources.quote: OR CONFORMITY WITH WHATEVER DOCUMENTATION IS PROVIDED

claims.statement: LDC, its host institution, data providers and corpus authors exclude liability for all damages, including direct damages, arising from furnishing or use of LDC Databases.

sources.quote: IN NO EVENT SHALL LDC, ITS HOST INSTITUTION, ITS DATA PROVIDERS OR CORPUS AUTHORS BE LIABLE FOR SPECIAL, DIRECT, INDIRECT

claims.statement: The LDC for-profit Member pays an annual membership fee set by the fee schedule in Exhibit A.

sources.quote: Member agrees to pay to LDC an annual membership fee, determined in accordance with the membership fee schedule

claims.statement: LDC may amend the fee schedule and Exhibit A licensing terms at the beginning of a new membership year.

sources.quote: as it may be amended from time to time at the beginning of a new membership year

claims.statement: LDC for-profit membership fees fall due each January 1 unless the Member gives sixty days' prior written notice that it will not renew.

sources.quote: unless Member provides sixty days' prior written notice that it does not intend to renew its membership

claims.statement: The LDC for-profit agreement defines each membership year as commencing January 1 (the printed text says it ends December 31 'of the following calendar year').

sources.quote: Each membership year shall commence on January 1 and end December 31 of the following calendar year

claims.statement: LDC for-profit membership fees are non-refundable.

sources.quote: Membership fees are non-refundable.

claims.statement: LDC Standard for-profit membership costs USD 34,000 per calendar year and entitles the Member to up to 16 LDC Databases from the membership year.

value.basis: annual fee paid by a for-profit Member for Standard Membership; up to 16 databases from that year

sources.quote: $34,000 per calendar year. Standard Member is entitled to receive up to 16 LDC Databases from the Membership Year

claims.statement: LDC Subscription for-profit membership costs USD 40,000 per calendar year and entitles the Member to copies of all LDC Databases released in that year.

value.basis: annual fee paid by a for-profit Member for Subscription Membership; all databases released that year

sources.quote: $40,000 per calendar year. Subscription Member is entitled to automatically receive copies of all LDC Databases released

claims.statement: A Standard Member may license further databases from the membership year at LDC's regular non-member licensing fee.

sources.quote: Additional LDC Databases from the Membership Year may be licensed at the regular, non-member licensing fee

claims.statement: LDC reserves the right to release databases that require separate licence agreements and additional fees beyond membership.

sources.quote: LDC reserves the right to release Databases that require separate license agreements and additional fees

claims.statement: The Section 1(b) licensing terms apply to both Standard and Subscription for-profit memberships.

sources.quote: All other licensing terms described in Section 1 (b) apply to both Membership types

claims.statement: The signatory Member represents that it is a for-profit corporation.

sources.quote: Member represents that it is a for-profit corporation

claims.statement: A for-profit Member's renewal payments stop if LDC notifies it that LDC has dissolved or no longer offers for-profit memberships generally.

sources.quote: LDC notifies Member that LDC has been dissolved or is no longer offering for-profit memberships generally
